name: x-account-insight-extension
description: See where X users are located and what devices they use. Country flags & device icons next to every username. Optional geo-blocking.

scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.package:chrome: rimraf dist/chrome && npm run build:chrome && node scripts/zip.js chrome
scripts.package:firefox: rimraf dist/firefox && npm run build:firefox && node scripts/zip.js firefox
scripts.package: npm run package:chrome && npm run package:firefox
scripts.check:profiles: node scripts/check-profiles.mjs && node scripts/check-profile-client.mjs && node scripts/check-profile-lookups.mjs
scripts.check:hover: npm run check:hover-intent && npm run check:hover-cache && npm run check:hover-loading && npm run check:hover-sync && npm run check:hover-avatar && npm run check:profile-link
scripts.check:regressions: node scripts/check-update-check.mjs && node scripts/check-rate-limit-bounds.mjs && node scripts/check-account-errors.mjs && node scripts/check-affiliation.mjs && node scripts/check-attribute-text.mjs && node scripts/check-hardening.mjs && node scripts/check-profile-evidence.mjs && node scripts/check-worker-regressions.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check:request-policy && npm run check:chat && npm run check:profiles && npm run check:regions && npm run check:cloud && npm run check:lists && npm run check:quick-filters && npm run check:post-card && npm run check:hover && npm run check:regressions
